title: What is at stake at the EU-UK summit in Brussels?
summary_full: Leaders will wrestle with easing Brexit red tape, restoring emissions trading and opening up youth mobilityUK politics live – latest updatesThe EU and UK will hold a long-awaited summit in Brussels on Friday – the second since Brexit – to hammer out the UK’s longer-term relationship with the bloc.It will be attended by the prime minister, Andy Burnham, the head of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, and the president of the European Council, António Costa.
